name: Magellan Discoverer Inaugural Air-Cruise

seo.title: Magellan Discoverer Inaugural Air-Cruise, Dec 2026
seo.description: The first voyage of Antarctica21's Magellan Discoverer: sail from Punta Arenas through Patagonia and the Beagle Channel, cross the Drake, then fly home from Antarctica. December 2026.

tagline: The maiden voyage: Patagonia, the Drake by sea, a flight home.
answer: The Magellan Discoverer Inaugural Air-Cruise is a single ten-day, nine-night departure in December 2026. The new ship sails from Punta Arenas through the Strait of Magellan, Glacier Alley and the Beagle Channel, crosses the Drake Passage, spends three days in Antarctica, then guests fly back to Punta Arenas. Antarctica21's page shows it as sold out.
overview: A one off voyage that brings Magellan Discoverer south for her first season. It is the only Antarctica21 air-cruise that sails out of Punta Arenas through Patagonia before the Drake.

inclusions: Group airport and hotel transfers in Punta Arenas
One hotel night with breakfast at the Cabo de Hornos Hotel (Day 9)
Flight from King George Island to Punta Arenas
Guided shore landings, Zodiac excursions, lectures and entertainment
Buffet breakfast and lunch, a la carte dinner, selected drinks and snacks on board
Contingency plan, loan of waterproof boots and the IAATO passenger fee
exclusions: International flights to and from the gateway city
Meals in Punta Arenas on the evening of the return flight
Medical insurance with aero medical evacuation cover (required by Antarctica21)
Optional sea kayaking, hiking and snowshoeing (priced separately)
Extra hotel nights (sold as a Hotel and Transfer Package)

optional.name: Sea kayaking
optional.note: Selected departures only. Up to 20 paddlers in two alternating groups of 10, per Antarctica21's 2027-28 season note.

optional.name: Hiking and snowshoeing
optional.note: Small group led by a guide, selected departures only.

optional.name: Hotel and Transfer Package
optional.note: Extra nights at the Cabo de Hornos Hotel or similar with group transfers.

children: Air-cruises: children must be at least 8 years old, at least 1.20 m (3.9 ft) tall and weigh 30 kg or more, travel with a responsible adult who signs a waiver. Children under 12 receive a 5% discount on the per person rate.
faqs: Can I still book the inaugural?
Antarctica21's page shows the departure as sold out.
Does it cross the Drake by sea?
Yes, southbound. Guests fly back from King George Island.
